question: At each original collecting policy, do recorded return-weighted directions from other families align with the held-out family direction after removing its own contribution?
evidence: E191 completed3444 updates but failed stochastic evaluation; E192 fixed-weight greedy evaluation gives20->20/128. E191 exact-state coefficient cancellation was18.897%, which was not a gradient measurement. The48 E192 first interventions have0 descriptor differences confined to raw indices.
data: Use all four completed E191 cohorts, each128 assigned fit families times4 recorded games. Keep original full-game Heart binary returns, same-family other-three return baseline, all nonforced decisions and original collecting actor. No historical evaluation returns enter the gradient. Later collecting actors had trained on earlier cohorts of these same families; this is not an unseen-family split.
quantity: For family i, h_i=(1/M) sum_t A_t grad_theta log pi_theta(a_t|s_t), at the exact collecting actor; M is all nonforced cohort decisions, including zero-advantage families. Compute h_i dot sum_(j!=i) h_j and its cosine, Gram matrix, squared aggregate norm/sum of squared family norms. The own positive h_i dot h_i must be excluded. Zero-contrast families contribute zero and remain in counts/denominators. No new family weighting.
verification: Bind completed E191 optimizer/native review, completion manifest, roles, every consumed episode and collecting checkpoint. Independently compute every nonzero family gradient with explicit NumPy softmax/ReLU derivatives and Torch autograd of the likelihood sum; absolute max component error<1e-9. NumPy collecting probabilities must differ<1e-10. Keep private gradients and Gram matrices. Three focused tests cover opposing and aligned families, unequal residual/temperature/signed advantages, exact cancellation and shared-action-offset invariance.
interpretation: Report every cohort, all128-family counts, mixed coverage, leave-one-family-out signs/cosines and norm ratios. For reporting only, a cross dot within1e-12 times the norm product is numerically zero. No p-value, tuned cutoff, checkpoint selection or success gate; no new learner or collection is authorized by this diagnostic.
limits: Euclidean local slopes of the recorded return-weighted likelihood objective are not causal Heart effects, a population signal-to-noise estimate, a guarantee for finite steps, or a reconstruction of clipped AdamW minibatch dynamics. Four stochastic returns per family make directions noisy. Families recur across cohorts and later policies depend on earlier training. Positive cross-family alignment does not prove generalization; negative alignment does not prove all useful learning impossible. No policy adoption or unused acceptance.
closure: Complete one audit of all four cohorts. Preserve failures without automatic reruns or tolerance relaxation. Use it to distinguish candidate explanations before another learning change, not as permission for more sampling.
